## Payment Terms (PT)

Negotiated terms as one compound value — net days, the early-pay discount pair, the preferred rail (reusing the existing PaymentMethodField), and a computed `shorthand` that renders the industry notation ("2/10 net 30") wherever terms appear. The discount-window math (deadline, cash value) belongs to whoever holds the invoice date; this field carries the parts, never a date. Edit format is the Payment Terms Editor component.

### Example

Contained example mirrors Acme Supply’s negotiated terms; the linked Vendor Profile carries it live.

### Non-goals

No enforcement — dunning/discount capture read these terms, they are not run by them. No per-invoice overrides (an invoice that deviates states its own terms).
